text:
Ms Georgine Ponsford 
Resident Community Nurse 
Community Retirement Home 
103 Light Street 
Newtown

11 February, 2014

Dear Ms Ponsford,

RE: Mr Lionel Ramamurthy, aged 63

Mr Ramamurthy was admitted to our hospital on 4 February 2014 with pneumonia. He is now ready for discharge back to your care.

Upon admission, Mr Ramamurthy presented with several symptoms that were consistent with pneumonia and required full assistance with ADLs. After being treated, he has made good progress and is able to manage his ADLs slowly but independently. ; however, he is still having a dry cough triggering pain over his chest and abdomen, which has been managed with Paracetamol given as needed, and the chest physiotherapy.

After discharge, Mr Ramamurthy requires encouragement to continue practicing deep breathing and coughing exercise as well as maintaining his upright posture more frequently. Also, please ensure that he keeps warm at all times.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,

RN
